summary: Reconciliation candidate for wave1_generic_runtime_objects: eight validated source proposals (180 functions) reconciled into one engine subsystem (GenericRuntimeObjects) with 78 canonical type families, 10 state machines, 21 interfaces, 297 dependencies, 45 compatibility contracts and 6 conflicts. Two same-named class proposals were merged on role/call/shared-field evidence (F1CVehicle x2, DERIVED; VehiclePhysicsState x2, GUESS, incl. cross-call 0x004F0050 -> 0x004E9630). All other UNKNOWN-owner functions stay unowned (carried in unresolved / unresolved_evidence_refs). No trust above DERIVED; agreement between proposals does not promote trust. Contradictions (field-name dispute, prelabel-vs-body mismatch, list-identity disagreement, guard-polarity ambiguity, legacy ABI leads) are recorded in conflicts, not erased. Field samples are treated as boundary clues only.
